description: Historical canon events for the Age of Rebellion (0-4 ABY). These events fire at specific arc stages to anchor the campaign in Star Wars Legends timeline.

events.title: Aftermath of the Battle of Yavin
events.event_text: Word spreads across the galaxy: the Death Star has been destroyed at Yavin. The Empire tightens its grip in response, launching crackdowns on suspected Rebel sympathizers. Imperial patrols double across Outer Rim hyperspace lanes.
immutable_facts: The Death Star was destroyed at the Battle of Yavin
The Empire is conducting widespread crackdowns on Rebel cells
events.director_hint: Reference Imperial paranoia and tightened security. News of Yavin should feel like a distant spark of hope mixed with fear of reprisal.

events.title: Imperial Retaliation Sweeps
events.event_text: Imperial Intelligence launches Operation Ringbreaker — systematic sweeps targeting known Rebel supply lines and recruitment cells. Several Alliance safe houses go dark overnight.
immutable_facts: Imperial Intelligence is running Operation Ringbreaker against Rebel cells
events.director_hint: The player should feel the Empire's reach closing in. Safe contacts may have gone silent. Supply runs are riskier.

events.title: Echo Base Established on Hoth
events.event_text: The Alliance relocates its main base to the ice planet Hoth. Rumors of a hidden Rebel command center reach the player through trusted contacts. The Rebellion is regrouping after Yavin, but Imperial probe droids are everywhere.
immutable_facts: The Alliance has established Echo Base on Hoth
Imperial probe droids are searching for the Rebel base
events.director_hint: The Rebellion is in a dangerous holding pattern — growing stronger but not yet ready for a direct confrontation. Logistics, supply runs, and intelligence gathering are critical.

events.title: The Battle of Hoth
events.event_text: The Empire discovers Echo Base. AT-AT walkers storm the Rebel defenses on Hoth. The Alliance is routed — transports flee under ion cannon cover while Rogue Squadron buys time. The Rebellion scatters across the galaxy.
immutable_facts: Echo Base on Hoth has been discovered and overrun by the Empire
The Alliance fleet has scattered after the Battle of Hoth
events.director_hint: This is a dark moment. Allies are scattered, communications are compromised, and the Empire seems unstoppable. The player should feel the desperation of a fragmented Rebellion.

events.title: Betrayal at Cloud City
events.event_text: Rumors reach the underworld: Darth Vader laid a trap at Cloud City on Bespin. Han Solo has been frozen in carbonite and handed to the bounty hunter Boba Fett. Luke Skywalker barely escaped after a devastating confrontation with Vader.
immutable_facts: Han Solo has been captured and frozen in carbonite at Cloud City
Luke Skywalker confronted Darth Vader at Cloud City and was defeated
events.director_hint: The stakes are personal now. Heroes can fall. The Empire's power feels absolute. Channel this into the player's own story — their allies and objectives are similarly at risk.

events.title: Rescue at Jabba's Palace
events.event_text: Word spreads through smuggler networks: Han Solo has been rescued from Jabba the Hutt's palace on Tatooine. Jabba is dead. Luke Skywalker — now calling himself a Jedi Knight — orchestrated the rescue.
immutable_facts: Han Solo has been rescued from Jabba the Hutt
Luke Skywalker has declared himself a Jedi Knight
events.director_hint: Hope is returning. A Jedi walks the galaxy again. The final confrontation with the Empire feels inevitable. The player should sense momentum shifting.

events.title: The Endor Briefing
events.event_text: The Alliance has obtained intelligence on a second, even larger Death Star being constructed above the forest moon of Endor. Mon Mothma calls the entire fleet together for an all-or-nothing assault. 'Many Bothans died to bring us this information.'
immutable_facts: A second Death Star is under construction above Endor
The Alliance is preparing an all-out assault on the second Death Star
events.director_hint: The endgame approaches. Everything the player has built leads to this moment. Weave their personal story into the larger galactic conflict.

events.title: The Battle of Endor
events.event_text: The second Death Star has been destroyed. Emperor Palpatine is dead. Darth Vader — redeemed in his final moments — is gone. Across the galaxy, celebrations erupt as the news spreads. The Empire's grip is broken. A New Republic rises from the ashes of rebellion.
immutable_facts: The second Death Star has been destroyed at the Battle of Endor
Darth Vader has been redeemed and is dead
The Galactic Empire's central command structure has collapsed
events.director_hint: Victory and its aftermath. The player's personal arc should resolve against the backdrop of galactic liberation. What does freedom mean after years of fighting?
